title: A Transformer-based Approach for Real-time Multi-agent Path Planning with Varying Initial/Final Conditions
abstract: arXiv:2610.30388v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We address the problem of real-time multi-agent path planning under prescribed initial and final configurations, formulated as a high-dimensional optimal control problem subject to inter-agent collision avoidance and obstacle constraints. Classical solvers based on the Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman equation or Pontryagin's maximum principle (PMP) become computationally intractable as the number of agents grows, due to the curse of dimensionality and the non-convexity introduced by interaction constraints. translated_title: 一种基于Transformer的可变初始/最终条件下实时多智能体路径规划方法
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在给定初始和最终构型下的实时多智能体路径规划问题，将其表述为一个受智能体间碰撞避免和障碍物约束的高维最优控制问题。基于Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman方程或庞特里亚金最大值原理（PMP）的经典求解方法，随着智能体数量的增加，由于维数灾难以及交互约束带来的非凸性，在计算上变得难以处理。我们提出OCFormer——一种基于Transformer的神经网络，它参数化了一个坐标变换的逆变换，将一个简单的、可解析处理的潜空间（其中各智能体在解耦的哈密顿量下独立演化）映射到耦合交互系统的物理空间。该模型通过最小化物理信息驱动的损失函数进行训练，该损失包括来自PMP的哈密顿常微分方程残差项和边界匹配项。
tldr: 提出OCFormer，一种通过物理信息损失训练的基于Transformer的神经网络，将解耦潜空间映射到耦合物理空间，从而实现具有可变初始/最终条件的实时高维多智能体路径规划。
en_tdlr: OCFormer, a transformer-based neural network trained with a physics-informed loss, maps a decoupled latent space to the coupled physical space, enabling real-time high-dimensional multi-agent path planning with varying initial/final conditions.
